The layout is anchored by a structured **fixed grid** model capped at a 1120px desktop container width, ensuring focused eye-tracking and structural harmony. Content padding follows an 8px baseline rhythm.

## Elevation & Depth

Depth is handled through a combination of crisp tonal layers and ultra-soft ambient shadows that lend physical tactility to interactive elements like the central prompt box.

## Brand & Style

This design system delivers a high-converting, polished digital experience that bridges playful creation with enterprise reliability. The aesthetic blends **Minimalism** with vibrant, expressive focal points—utilizing a cream and pale hero canvas that transitions dynamically into deep, immersive blues, punctuated by striking pink and red pulse artwork. 

The emotional response should feel instantaneous, empowering, and deeply creative—inviting users to manifest software effortlessly while retaining absolute confidence in the underlying architecture.

## Colors

The palette establishes immediate atmospheric contrast, moving from a warm, welcoming cream hero field down into sophisticated deep blues. Accent hues—drawn directly from the pulse artwork—inject high-energy vibrancy into interactive states and key brand moments. Neutrals are carefully calibrated to maintain legibility against both pale and dark surfaces.

## Typography

Typography relies entirely on **Camera Plain Variable**, providing a clean, geometric yet approachable voice. The scale utilizes large, commanding hero headers that scale gracefully down to mobile viewports (transitioning from 48px to 32px), supported by meticulously tracked body and label styles for optimal readability across data-dense sections and interactive prompts.
